description: This file defines the SyncOpStatus class which manages and tracks the status of synchronization operations, including error handling, timing monitors, and event notifications within a synchronization process.

classes.name: SyncOpStatus
classes.description: A class responsible for managing and monitoring the status of synchronization operations, including progress, timing, errors, and event notifications.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Stops the timing monitor and performs cleanup.

methods.name: setUploadStatus
methods.description: Updates the upload progress and notifies the receiver.

methods.name: setDownloadStatus
methods.description: Updates the download count and notifies the receiver.

methods.name: setDatabaseLoadStatus
methods.description: Updates the database load progress and status, notifying the receiver of completion or incremental load.

methods.name: getStats
methods.description: Returns the current statistics of upload/download progress and database load status.

methods.name: setDidBegin
methods.description: Marks the start of a sync operation and records the start time.

methods.name: setDidEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of a sync operation.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if an error has occurred during sync.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets an error state for the sync process.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the status counters, error state, and stops timers to prepare for a new sync cycle.
